title: Make a controller reply
summary: Phoenix: Make a controller reply. Change the greeting.
introduction: The router maps GET /hello to a controller action. text sends a plain response.
learningObjectives: Make a controller reply with Phoenix

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Make a controller reply
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/hello", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def hello(conn, _params), do: text(conn, "Hello, Asha!")
end

blocks.text: The router names the controller action. text sends the greeting through the connection value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The SchoolWeb module prefix must match the app name school.
